entities.summary: Ronald Kirk is an American lawyer and politician who served as the United States Trade Representative from 2009 to 2013, as the 97th secretary of state of Texas, and as the 56th mayor of Dallas from 1995 to 2002. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Ron Kirk was a legal figures from Austin (b. 1954-06-27, Austin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
